ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Faces of amenability: groups, actions, measures, spaces. See http://www.math.uiuc.edu/timetable/ for the full course description. Students from the following programs must contact the Director of Graduate Studies in Mathematics <Laugesen@illinois.edu> to request permission to register for the course: MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, MS:Statistics -UIUC, MS:Statistics -- Applied -UIUC, MS: Statistics: Analytics, or MS: Financial Engineering.
